documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our manufacturing team struggles with duplicate follow-ups. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer explicitly mentions that their manufacturing team struggles with duplicate follow-ups, and they are seeking workflow coordination and account reporting. They have requested a discovery meeting to clarify their requirements but have not approved a budget. The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east'. The operational friction is the 'duplicate follow-ups' issue in their manufacturing team.

claims.quote: Our manufacturing team struggles with duplicate follow-ups.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your manufacturing team is currently facing challenges with duplicate follow-ups, and you are seeking workflow coordination and account reporting to address this. A discovery meeting would be a great next step to better understand your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. We look forward to connecting with you.
questions: What specific systems or tools are currently being used for workflow coordination and account reporting?
Are there any specific integration requirements or existing vendor systems that need to be connected?
What are the key performance indicators or outcomes you expect from workflow coordination?
uncertainties: The customer has not approved a budget, which may impact the timeline or scope of the discovery meeting.
The exact nature of the duplicate follow-ups and their impact on productivity or costs is not specified.
